correctness.rationale: The proof derives the exact block Hamiltonian from individual allowed token moves, obtains all singular frequencies and multiplicities from unsigned incidence identities, computes a localized state's orthogonal sector weights and the exact time-dependent probability, and proves the all-r balanced supremum using irrationality of sqrt((r-1)/(r-2)) and torus density. Nonattainment follows from the impossibility of an odd-integer frequency ratio. The classical formula is an exact two-class generator solution. The included independent enumerative script passed six exact characteristic-polynomial cases, 24 unitary-probability comparisons and nine classical-probability comparisons. No finite check is substituted for the all-size proof.

originality.rationale: Inspected same-graph Laplacian blocks are serious antecedents, and the classical lumped process is already known. The restricted new proposition is the exact hard-core coherent same-shore probability, the all-size irrational-frequency global supremum with strict nonattainment, and its time-matched classical contrast; neither the zero-mode projector nor the upper envelope alone is claimed as original. The collision-loss projector supplies the identical double-centered zero-energy dark modes and therefore already implies the quantum same-shore upper bound; the bound alone is covered. Neither it, the general symmetric-square theory, the Laplacian spectrum nor Grover dynamics states the sharp attainable-as-a-supremum but never finitely attained result or exact unitary probability law. The published Laplacian proof closely supplies the block method; this materially limits originality and leaves residual risk of implicit derivability or a historical direct equivalent.
